title: Zero-shot protein stability prediction by inverse folding models: a free energy interpretation
relevance: Provides free-energy foundations for inverse folding stability prediction. Shows standard likelihood ratios are a simplistic approximation and suggests improved estimates. Direct theoretical basis for this concept.
key_finding: Considerable gains in zero-shot stability prediction achievable with simple improvements over standard likelihood ratio approach.

title: Rewiring protein sequence and structure generative models to enhance protein stability prediction (SPURS)
relevance: SPURS integrates PLM + inverse folding model with supervised fine-tuning on mega-scale data. Demonstrates the combined oracle approach with state-of-the-art results.
key_finding: Rewiring and integrating ESM-2 + ESM-IF with mega-scale fine-tuning delivers accurate, efficient, and generalizable stability predictions.

title: Predicting mutational effects on protein binding from folding energy (StaB-ddG)
relevance: Uses pre-trained inverse folding model as proxy for folding energy with transfer learning. First deep learning predictor matching FoldX accuracy at 1000x speedup.
key_finding: Parameterizing binding energy as difference between complex and partner folding energies from inverse folding achieves FoldX-level accuracy at 1000x speed.
